text:
maria (procurement): Heads up — Vendor Omega just updated lead times on H200s. They pushed our Q2 top-off from 3w -> 6w. They flagged 12 units as 'RMA-park' at origin.
kevin (supply-ops): Ugh. Which 12? Pool units or customer returns?
maria (procurement): They said 'fresh inventory held for RMA pool; not saleable until QA'. PO: `PO-78312`. Linda from Omega pinged earlier.
olivia (eng-infra): If those are park units we could request a temporary loaner (1:1) to keep Dedicated pools full. But there’s cost. What's the pricing delta?
kevin (supply-ops): Linda, can you confirm pricing + SLA credits if they stay parked? Also any early-release options / expedite fees?
linda (vendor_omega): Confirmed — 12 units are flagged due to firmware batch. We can release 6 vetted units in 2w (additional test fee), rest in 6w. Expedited shipping available: +12% freight, +$480/unit test/rework. No SLA credits by default, but we can negotiate a partial credit for late delivery on the committed allocation.
jamal (logistics): If we accept 6 now and 6 later we need AWB splits. Customs may charge extra for split manifests. Could be ~€300 per split in EU.
olivia (eng-infra): From runtime side, losing 12 units will push queue latency at edge pools by ~18% for batch workloads. Can we re-route some capacity from US to EU temporarily? Region constraints + cost ops.
kevin (supply-ops): Two options: A) pay expedite + splitted AWB; B) take a deferred credit and wait 6w. We should compute unit economics: expedite cost vs estimated lost revenue / SLA risk.
maria (procurement): Quick calc draft: expedite shipping + rework = $480 + 12% freight (~$120) => ~$600/unit. Deferred credit proposal: vendor offers 5% credit on those 12 units pro-rated. If our margin loss on capacity is >$600/unit over the 6w window, expedite is justified.
linda (vendor_omega): We can increase the credit to 8% if you commit to the full tranche and sign an addendum. Addendum also waives rework fee on the first 6 units.
kevin (supply-ops): That changes math. @olivia — can you estimate marginal cost of slowed throughput in dollars for 6 weeks? Even a ballpark helps.
olivia (eng-infra): Ballpark: ~$45k over 6 weeks in additional infra + session retry costs across customers (based on current load). Spread over 12 units ~ $3.75k/unit. So expedite looks cheaper per unit.
jamal (logistics): Note: expedited air increases chance of customs inspection. Need pre-clear docs. If we split AWBs, Ops will need to file two entries for EU, add hold risk.
maria (procurement): Proposal: accept Linda's improved addendum: release 6 vetted units in 2w (no rework fee), vendor credits 8% on tranche, we pay expedited freight for the first 6. For the remaining 6, accept 8% credit when they ship in 6w. Agree?
kevin (supply-ops): I support. Also request vendor to include serials list now so we can update our node-tagging and avoid deployment surprises.
linda (vendor_omega): Will provide serials + preflight test logs by EOD. Can we confirm shipping terms: DAP (our EU DC) or Delivered? DAP preferred.
jamal (logistics): DAP is fine. Once serials come in, I'll book courier and prepare split AWBs. Ops-bot: create ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-8672 — "Vendor Omega H200 partial release + RMA-park coordination". Assignees: jamal, kevin, maria. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-8672
olivia (eng-infra): One more ask — can we get firmware inventory map? If the batch is firmware-only we may be able to deploy with a temporary config flag and rollback on firmware fix.
linda (vendor_omega): We'll include firmware diff and test vectors with serials. If you choose to deploy patched units behind a feature-flag, we can sign off faster.
maria (procurement): Good. Next steps: 1) Linda sends serials + docs EOD; 2) Jamal books DAP courier once docs in; 3) Legal to prep addendum for 8% credit and waive rework fee for first 6; 4) Olivia to validate risk of temporary deploy. I'll loop in Legal and Finance after this thread.
kevin (supply-ops): tagging @linda — please cc `legal@vendor-omega.com` on the addendum.
linda (vendor_omega): Will do. Thanks everyone.
kevin (supply-ops): :thumbsup: 
maria (procurement): Thanks — will update exec when ticket has AWB and addendum attached.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 72h for INF-8672 follow-up.
